metadata.description: Machinery for a portable OKF knowledge memory. Plugins here ship tooling, never the knowledge itself; bundles stay separate git clones.

plugins.name: brainalyser
plugins.description: A shared brain your agent reads before answering and writes to after learning. Interviews you to build a structure that matches how you think, backfills your existing history, then keeps itself honest with a daily harvest, a weekly audit and a conformance validator. Ships no knowledge; the bundle stays a separate git clone located via BRAIN_REPO.
